messages.subject: Bracken v Calderwood - your witness statement and possible mediation
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

Two things ahead of the 22 May exchange. First, your witness statement is in good shape - it covers the selection of Calderwood, the pressure failures from batch B-2408, your notice emails to Gerald Doyle, the delivery failures and the termination, and squarely addresses their alleged oral variation. I'll send the final for your signature this week.

Second, Pemberton Rowe have again raised mediation. Given Catherine's view, I think a mediation in June/July could be worthwhile. Would you be open to it?

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
